name: TC-002: Arm Home and Disarm partitions

steps.name: Before Hooks
Navigate back to home page

Expect "toBeHidden" getByRole('button', { name: /^Accept All$/i }).or(getByRole('button', { name: /^Confirm my choices$/i })).or(locator('#truste-consent-button')).or(getByRole('dialog').filter({ hasText: 'This website uses cookies.' }).getByRole('button', { name: 'OK', exact: true })).filter({ visible: true }).first()
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('button', { name: 'Devices' }).first()
Ensure all partitions are disarmed before test
Expect "toBeVisible" getByText(/^\s*(Armed Home|Armed Away|Disarmed|Arming|Disarming)\s*$/).filter({ visible: true }).first()
Evaluate getByText(/^\s*(Armed Home|Armed Away|Disarmed|Arming|Disarming)\s*$/).filter({ visible: true })
Select all partitions
Expect "toBeVisible" getByText(/^(SELECT ALL|DESELECT ALL)$/i).filter({ visible: true }).first().or(getByRole('checkbox', { name: /^Toggle P\d+\s*-/ }).filter({ visible: true })).first()
Query count getByRole('checkbox', { name: /^Toggle P\d+\s*-/ }).filter({ visible: true })
Check getByRole('checkbox', { name: /^Toggle P\d+\s*-/ }).filter({ visible: true }).first()
Expect "toBeChecked" getByRole('checkbox', { name: /^Toggle P\d+\s*-/ }).filter({ visible: true }).first()
Check getByRole('checkbox', { name: /^Toggle P\d+\s*-/ }).filter({ visible: true }).nth(1)
Expect "toBeChecked" getByRole('checkbox', { name: /^Toggle P\d+\s*-/ }).filter({ visible: true }).nth(1)
Arm Home
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('button, .panelActionText').filter({ hasText: /^\s*ARM HOME(?: ALL)?\s*$/i }).filter({ visible: true }).first()
Click locator('button, .panelActionText').filter({ hasText: /^\s*ARM HOME(?: ALL)?\s*$/i }).filter({ visible: true }).first()
Every visible partition must reach "Armed Home"
Evaluate getByText(/^\s*(Armed Home|Armed Away|Disarmed|Arming|Disarming)\s*$/).filter({ visible: true })
Every visible partition must reach "Armed Home"
